about: Hindi written by machine in C5 (6 November 2026) for keys added or changed since the wave 6 removal: not yet reviewed by a person. The founder chose to ship it as it is, and Settings says plainly it is machine-translated. The rest of the pack is the machine-drafted Hindi of waves 2 to 5, restored unchanged where its English did not change. A key missing here shows the English words. When a reviewer has read a key, take it off this list. On 15 November 2026 Hindi was machine-drafted for every key that had none (486 keys across 21 files, with a new hi/whats-new.json) and for the keys added that day; all of them are at the end of this list, not yet reviewed by a person.
